identity.real_world_identity_notes: The PMR Esperante GTR-1 is the Panoz/Reynard GT1 race car introduced for the 1997 season, not the existing 2005 Panoz Esperante GTLM record and not the 1998 Q9 hybrid variant. The FIA homologation record names the car Panoz GTR, with an Xtrac six-speed sequential gearbox.

The FIA homologation form is valid from 1 April 1997 and identifies Panoz GTR; Panoz's manufacturer history identifies the Esperante GTR-1 endurance program from 1997 onward; and the exact 1998 Le Mans entry page identifies a Panoz Esperante GTR-1 in LM GT1. These sources match the existing simulator-independent record and distinguish the adjacent road and Q9 configurations.

claims.basis: Panoz's official history and the PMR page identify the Esperante GTR-1 as a 1997 GT1 race car; the FIA homologation form valid from April 1997 identifies Panoz GTR and records six ratios with a sequential gear-change gate.

The FIA ratio table lists six forward gears and PMR reports six-speed sequential. The FIA gear-change gate and technical summary both identify sequential construction/selection. The technical summary describes a manual sequential gearbox operated by a cockpit gear lever; the PMR observation reports sequential-stick. FIA explicitly records the gear-change gate as sequential.
